name: Urbana, IL
program: U-Cart single-stream recycling (City of Urbana Public Works)

office-paper.quote: Ledgers, file folders, or computer paper

books.quote: Paperback and hardcover books (Please limit to 20 lbs. per set out.)

paperboard-box.quote: Paperboard (Waxed paperboard is ok.), such as cereal boxes, frozen food boxes

pizza-box-greasy.quote: Food-soiled boxes, such as pizza boxes, take-out containers

paper-takeout-container.quote: Food-soiled boxes, such as pizza boxes, take-out containers

paper-cup-hot.quote: Single-use paper products, such as paper towels, napkins, tissue paper, cups/plates

paper-plates-napkins.quote: Single-use paper products, such as paper towels, napkins, tissue paper, cups/plates

waxed-cardboard.note: Page says waxed paperboard is accepted; waxed cardboard boxes are not named.

pet-bottle.quote: 1 PETE (Polyethylene, Terephthalate): Soft drink and water bottles or food containers

hdpe-jug.quote: 2 HDPE (High Density Polyethylene): Milk jugs, and detergent bottles

plastic-tub.quote: 5 PP (Polypropylene): Yogurt cups, syrup bottles, deli trays, plant pots

plastic-clamshell.quote: Any color plastic food or beverage container, except Styrofoam, may be recycled.

plastic-cup-disposable.quote: 6 PS (Polystyrene): Rigid #6 plastics only, such as to-go coffee lids, disposable cups, or bakery containers (No Styrofoam)

plastic-cup-lid.quote: 6 PS (Polystyrene): Rigid #6 plastics only, such as to-go coffee lids, disposable cups, or bakery containers (No Styrofoam)

bottle-caps.quote: Leave caps/lids on bottles and jars

plastic-bag-film.quote: Plastic film, such as Ziploc bags, bread bags, newspaper sleeves
plastic-bag-film.note: Clean #2/#4 grocery bags are taken at Walgreens drop-off, per the city drop-off page.

chip-bag-wrapper.quote: Food packaging wrappers, such as chip bags, candy wrappers, fast food wrappers, etc.

foam-block.quote: Styrofoam (foam) products, such as egg cartons, deli or meat trays, packaging "peanuts,” etc.

foam-food-container.quote: Styrofoam (foam) products, such as egg cartons, deli or meat trays, packaging "peanuts,” etc.

plastic-flowerpot.quote: 5 PP (Polypropylene): Yogurt cups, syrup bottles, deli trays, plant pots (plant pots must be rinsed free of dirt, and caps/lids)

plastic-hard-6.quote: 6 PS (Polystyrene): Rigid #6 plastics only, such as to-go coffee lids, disposable cups, or bakery containers (No Styrofoam)

aerosol-can.quote: Empty aerosol cans, except for paint cans

paint-can.quote: Hazardous waste, such as motor oil, pesticide containers, paint, batteries, etc.
paint-can.note: Aerosol rule excludes paint cans; paint is listed as hazardous waste.

scrap-metal.note: Not accepted in the cart; the city drop-off page lists scrap vendors (Mack's Twin City Recycling, Mervis Recycling).

battery-alkaline.quote: Hazardous waste, such as motor oil, pesticide containers, paint, batteries, etc.

battery-lithium.quote: Hazardous waste, such as motor oil, pesticide containers, paint, batteries, etc.

glass-bottle-jar.quote: All colors of glass bottles and jars

food-scraps.note: Urbana's curbside program has no food scrap cart on this page; it is listed as not acceptable in the U-Cart.

household-chemicals.quote: Hazardous waste, such as motor oil, pesticide containers, paint, batteries, etc.

large-appliances-furniture.quote: Appliances Mack's Twin City Recycling 2808 North Lincoln Avenue, Urbana 217-328-2100 Please call for acceptable items and fees.
